text: 7月18日，在2026世界人工智能大会（WAIC）期间，由工业和信息化部中小企业发展促进中心发起的中国中小企业国际合作协会太空计算服务专业委员会正式成立。作为国内首个聚焦太空计算、面向广大中小企业服务的全国性产业协同平台，专委会将搭建一体化产业对接载体，助力中小企业贯通星地算力全产业链条，助推我国空天信息产业高质量发展。东方天算作为专委会常务理事单位，联合四十余家产业链上下游主体，共同构建产学研用深度融合的产业枢纽。（界面）(金十数据APP)
text_en: On July 18, during the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC), the Space Computing Service Professional Committee of the China International Cooperation Association of Small and Medium Enterprises, initiated by the SME Development Promotion Center of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, was officially established. As the first national industrial collaboration platform focused on space computing and serving small and medium-sized enterprises, the committee will build an integrated industry-academia-research-application hub to help SMEs connect the entire satellite-ground computing power industry chain, boosting the high-quality development of China's aerospace information industry. Oriental TianSuan, as a standing council member unit of the committee, joined over 40 upstream and downstream industry chain entities to co-build an industry hub for deep integration of industry, academia, research, and application. (Jiemian) (Jin10 Data APP)
